name: Selah J. Griffin
role: Early Kirtland elder sent to Missouri
dateNote: He was ordained an elder on 6 June 1831, the day section 52 named him.
importance: Section 52 tells him to be ordained and travel to Missouri with Newel Knight. Section 56 cancels that pairing because of rebellion among the Saints at Thompson. It sends him with Thomas B. Marsh instead. He settled in Jackson County and later served in the Seventy.
connections: His named companions are Newel Knight and Thomas B. Marsh.

sources.title: Selah J. Griffin, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born c. 1795, Virginia; in Kirtland by 1826; baptized by June 1831; elder 6 June 1831; Jackson and Clay Counties; Second Quorum of the Seventy 1835; living in Pike County, Illinois, as a blacksmith in 1860. Death not recorded.
